subject: Sunburst AI — renewal: scale swap + credit matrix proposal
messages:
From: Olivia Park <olivia.park@sunburst.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-04-10T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Renewal discussion — proposed scale and credits

Hi Marissa,

Hope you’re well. Our current agreement is up for renewal on 2027-06-01. We’ve been happy with performance, and there's significant internal interest in expanding to an additional 40% planned capacity across inference and embeddings in Q3.

Before we lock in a longer term, procurement wants clarity on:
- a short-term price hold (60–90 days) while we finalize budget approvals,
- a one-time onboarding credit to offset migration work, and
- a staged commit increase with a predictable credit ladder if usage ramps slower than expected.

Attached is a one-page summary of what we had in mind (Sunburst_MA_plan_v3.pdf). Can Redwood outline the options and any constraints (SLA, billing cadence, PO requirements)?

Thanks — would appreciate a quick sync next week.

Best,
Olivia Park
Head of Platform Operations
Sunburst AI

Attachment: Sunburst_MA_plan_v3.pdf (1 page summary)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Olivia Park <olivia.park@sunburst.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-04-11T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal discussion — proposed scale and credits

Hi Olivia — thanks for the clear summary.

We can absolutely work with a short price hold window and a staged commit structure. I’ve looped in Ben (pricing) so we can convert your asks into a concrete matrix — discount tiers, onboarding credit, and proposed true-up timing. A few quick clarifying Qs:
1) Is the 40% capacity increase targeted at latency-critical endpoints (low-latency inference) or primarily batch embedding jobs?
2) Does Sunburst require an invoice cadence aligned to quarter start or net-30 from invoice? Procurement sometimes requests PO/advance payment arrangements.

I can schedule a 30-minute call Mon/Tue next week. If we agree on the outline, Ben will draft a priced MA and we’ll mark a 90-day price hold option for you.

—Marissa

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Olivia Park <olivia.park@sunburst.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-04-12T15:22:00-07:00
Subject: RE: Renewal discussion — proposed scale and credits

Hi Olivia / Marissa — following up with a couple of concrete options (see attached pricing_credit_matrix.xlsx):

Option A (Conservative):
- 12-month renewal, base commit +40% (phased month 1–3),
- 5% off list for the incremental buckets,
- one-time onboarding credit: $25k applied against first invoice,
- price hold: 60 days from signed MA,
- true-up at quarter close; unused incremental commit converts to pre-paid credit applied to next quarter.

Option B (Accelerated):
- 24-month renewal, base commit +60% immediately,
- 10% off list on incremental usage up to commit,
- onboarding credit: $40k,
- price hold: 90 days,
- invoice cadence: monthly net-30; finance can accept emailed invoice + PO.

Notes:
- We’d need a signed amendment for any price hold period longer than 30 days to lock the tier; longer holds require a modest commitment uplift.
- SLA exceptions for burst capacity are handled as a paid add-on; we can include a 30-day grace for first major incident under the renewed term.

Attachment: pricing_credit_matrix.xlsx (pricing scenarios and modeled TCO)

Happy to jump on a call to walk through the numbers — can do Tue 4/13 afternoon.

—Ben
Ben Carter
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference

From: Sunburst Procurement <procurement@sunburst.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Emma Chen <emma.chen@sunburst.ai>
Date: 2027-04-14T08:37:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal discussion — proposed scale and credits

Team,

Appreciate the options. Procurement has a few constraints:
- We need invoice dates aligned to calendar quarter starts where possible (we prefer invoice on 6/30 for Q2 spend).
- Any onboarding credit must be tracked separately on the invoice with a clear expiry (we prefer 12 months).
- Price hold of 90 days is acceptable only if Sunburst commits to a minimum uplift (we're proposing a forecasting covenant rather than a strict monetary commitment).

I’ve uploaded our standard redline PDF (SOW-Sunburst-2027.docx) with requested changes (section 4.2 billing cadence, section 6.1 PO requirement). We also need DocuSign routing for legal once terms are agreed: https://docusign.com/sunburst/DB-3491-SB

Can Redwood confirm you can meet the invoice timing and explicitly list the credit expiry on the invoice line?

Best,
Procurement Team
Sunburst AI

Attachment: SOW-Sunburst-2027.docx (contract redlines)

From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-04-20T11:09:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal discussion — proposed scale and credits

Marissa/Ben — finance reviewed procurement's requested billing cadence. We can align invoice to quarter boundaries, but a few conditions:
- If invoicing on 6/30 for Q2, we need PO/confirmation by 6/15 to lock provisioning and capacity planning.
- Onboarding credit expiry: we can mark credits as 12-month expiry on invoice; unused credit will roll into service credit for future invoices only (not refundable).
- For the 90-day price hold: finance prefers a minimum uplift threshold (10% incremental commit) or a refundable deposit equal to one month of projected incremental usage.

We can accept emailed PO + PDF as binding for invoicing, but larger customers (> $250k ARR) should use signed DocuSign for the MA. Rafael can help model cashflow impact if Sunburst prefers no deposit.

—Stephanie
Stephanie Nguyen
Director, Finance Operations | Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Olivia Park <olivia.park@sunburst.ai>, Sunburst Procurement <procurement@sunburst.ai>, Emma Chen <emma.chen@sunburst.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>, Rafael Mendes <rafael_mendes@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-04-22T14:55:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal discussion — proposed scale and credits

Olivia / Procurement — thanks for the quick responses and the redlines. To summarize the path forward so everyone is aligned:

1) Redwood will deliver a revised MA and SOW with the following commitments by EOD 4/23: pricing table (Option B, with a fallback to Option A), an explicit 90-day price hold window, and invoice language that lists the onboarding credit as a separate line item with 12-month expiry.
2) Sunburst to provide PO or emailed confirmation by 6/15 to enable capacity provisioning for a 6/30 invoice. If Sunburst prefers to avoid a deposit, Rafael will model the cashflow impact and propose an alternative (partial prepay or staged invoices).
3) Legal/DocuSign: once the MA is accepted, we’ll route through DocuSign (I’ll include Procurement and Emma for sign-off).

Ben will attach the revised pricing_credit_matrix and Rafael will include the modeled cashflow scenarios. Suggested next step: 30-minute alignment call on Mon 4/26 to finalize the MA before drafting DocuSign.

Marissa Cole
